tools.name: domain_profile
tools.description: Everything about a domain in one call: DNS, WHOIS, TLS, DNSSEC, email auth, security score, blacklist status, plus IP intelligence for its A record. Price $0.025 per call. Free sample: {"domain": "example.com"}. Returns: data.sections.{dns,whois,tls,dnssec,email-auth,security-score,blacklist,ip}; da

A risk score and verdict (likely_safe / caution / high_risk, or inconclusive when a check could not run) with plain-English reasons, from domain age, spam/abuse blocklists and the HTTPS certificate. Price $0.020 per call. Free sample: {"domain":

tools.name: domain_dns
tools.description: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT and other records for a domain, with resolve timing. Price $0.005 per call. Free sample: {"domain": "example.com"}. Returns: data.data.records keyed by record type (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, ...); data.data.responseTime.

tools.name: domain_whois
tools.description: Registrar, creation and expiry dates, nameservers and status codes for a domain. Price $0.005 per call. Free sample: {"domain": "example.com"}. Returns: data.data.data: the parsed WHOIS/RDAP record (registrar, dates, nameservers, status).

tools.name: domain_age
tools.description: How old a domain is: registration date, age in days and years, and whether it was registered in the last 30 days (a common phishing signal). Price $0.005 per call. Free sample: {"domain": "example.com"}. Returns: data: created, age_days, age_years, newly_registered, expires, registrar, source.

tools.name: domain_available
tools.description: Is this domain name registered? Asked of the registry over RDAP, with the standard first-year and renewal price when it is free to register. Price $0.005 per call. Free sample: {"domain": "example.com"}. Returns: data: available (true/false; null when only DNS could be checked, then likely_available

tools.name: domain_tls
tools.description: Certificate validity, issuer, protocol and days until expiry for a domain. Price $0.005 per call. Free sample: {"domain": "example.com"}. Returns: data.data: valid, issuer, subject, subjectAltNames, validFrom, validTo, daysUntilExpiry, protocol, cipher, selfSigned.

tools.name: domain_dnssec
tools.description: Whether DNSSEC is signed and validates for a domain. Price $0.005 per call. Free sample: {"domain": "example.com"}. Returns: data.data: isSigned, isValid, validationStatus, chainOfTrust, dsRecords, dnskeyRecords, errors, warnings, recommendations.

tools.name: domain_email_auth
tools.description: SPF, DKIM and DMARC records and posture for a domain. Price $0.005 per call. Free sample: {"domain": "example.com"}. Returns: data.data: spf, dkim, dmarc, mx, overallScore, overallStatus, recommendations.

tools.name: domain_security_score
tools.description: A letter grade and point score for a domain security posture, with the scored items behind it. Price $0.005 per call. Free sample: {"domain": "example.com"}. Returns: data.data: grade, overallScore, maxPossibleScore, categories[] of scored items.

tools.name: domain_blacklist
tools.description: Whether the addresses behind a domain appear on spam and abuse blocklists. Price $0.005 per call. Free sample: {"domain": "example.com"}. Returns: data.data.ipResults[]: target, isListed, listingCount, totalChecked.

tools.name: ip_lookup
tools.description: Network owner (ASN), company, geolocation, privacy flags and abuse contact for an IP address. Price $0.005 per call. Free sample: {"ip": "1.1.1.1"}. Returns: data.data: ip, hostname, city, region, country, asn, company, privacy, carrier, abuse.

tools.name: site_status
tools.description: Live check of one or more URLs: HTTP status, latency, DNS resolve time, resolved IP, TTL, nameservers, TLS days remaining. Price $0.005 per call. Free sample: {"sites": ["https://example.com"]}. Returns: data keyed by URL; each entry has ok, code, ms, dns_ms, ip, ttl, ns, cert_days, server, ts.

tools.name: site_screenshot
tools.description: See a web page: a 1280-wide JPEG of any public URL, viewport or full page (capped at 6000 px), with its final URL, HTTP status and title. Price $0.020 per call. Free sample: {"url": "https://example.com"}. Returns: data: image_base64 (JPEG), mime, width, height, final_url, http_status, title, note.

tools.name: page_watch
tools.description: Has this page changed since your last call, and how much? The first call stores a baseline; later calls return a text diff (2% threshold). Price $0.005 per call. Free sample: {"url": "https://example.com"}. Returns: data with baseline, changed, change_pct, added, removed, last_change_ts.

tools.name: bot_observatory
tools.description: Partner tier of the dns.pizza bot observatory: every network (ASN), named crawler, TLS (JA4) fingerprint and firewall rule seen in the last 7 days, refreshed hourly. The public tier is free at https://dns.pizza/bots. Price $0.050 per call. Returns: data.data: generated_at, networks, bots, fingerprin

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: site_status · Private data: domain_profile, domain_dns, domain_whois, domain_email_auth, ip_lookup · Public sink: domain_profile, domain_email_auth · Destructive: domain_trust.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: site_status · Private data: domain_profile, domain_dns, domain_whois, domain_email_auth, ip_lookup · Public sink: domain_profile, domain_email_auth · Destructive: domain_trust

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
